transport.go_start.title: Return to start
transport.go_start.text: Moves the playhead to the beginning of the song.

transport.stop.title: Stop
transport.stop.text: Stops playback or recording. Where the playhead ends up follows the Return to start on stop preference of the Workflow settings.

transport.play.title: Play
transport.play.text: Starts the song from the playhead. While the song is playing the same button stops it. The lit button means the song is running.

transport.record.title: Record
transport.record.text: Records into the armed tracks: notes and audio you play, and the parameters you move when automation recording is on. Everything you record is one undo step.

transport.auto_lanes.title: Auto-create lanes
transport.auto_lanes.text: While it is lit, a take also records every parameter you move and adds an automation lane for it, so you do not have to make the lanes first.

transport.loop.title: Loop
transport.loop.text: Plays the range between the left and right locators over and over. Set the range with the locators.

transport.metronome.title: Metronome
transport.metronome.text: Plays a click on every beat while the song plays or records. The click level is set with the Click level control.

transport.override.title: Overridden lanes
transport.override.text: Some automation lanes hold a value you moved by hand while the song plays. Click to let all of them play their automation again.

transport.tempo.title: Tempo
transport.tempo.text: The speed of the song in beats per minute. Drag or scroll the number to change it, hold Shift for fine steps, or double-click to type a value. Tempo changes along the song are drawn in the tempo lane.

transport.meter.title: Time signature
transport.meter.text: How many beats a bar has and which note value is a beat. Drag or scroll either number, or double-click to type.

transport.rewind.title: Rewind
transport.rewind.text: Moves the playhead back by bars. Hold the button to repeat; the longer you hold it, the faster it goes.

transport.forward.title: Fast forward
transport.forward.text: Moves the playhead forward by bars. Hold the button to repeat; the longer you hold it, the faster it goes.

transport.tap_tempo.title: Tap tempo
transport.tap_tempo.text: Tap the beat on this button. The average of your last taps sets the tempo of the song.

transport.go_left.title: Go to the left locator
transport.go_left.text: Moves the playhead to the left end of the loop range.

transport.go_right.title: Go to the right locator
transport.go_right.text: Moves the playhead to the right end of the loop range.

transport.left_locator.title: Left locator
transport.left_locator.text: The start of the loop range, written as bar, beat and tick. Double-click to type a new position.

transport.right_locator.title: Right locator
transport.right_locator.text: The end of the loop range, written as bar, beat and tick. Double-click to type a new position.

transport.click_level.title: Click level
transport.click_level.text: How loud the metronome is. Drag or scroll to change it, or double-click to go back to the default.

transport.q_rec.title: Q Rec
transport.q_rec.text: Quantizes the notes you record: each note snaps to the grid next to this button as it is played in. Off keeps your timing exactly.

transport.q_rec_grid.title: Q Rec grid
transport.q_rec_grid.text: The grid the recorded notes snap to when Q Rec is on. Click, drag or scroll to change it.

transport.quantize.title: Quantize
transport.quantize.text: Quantizes the selected clips or notes with the last settings of the quantize panel, so you can repeat the same quantize with one click.

transport.song_key.title: Song key
transport.song_key.text: The key of the song at the playhead. Click to set it; the piano roll, the browser and the chord tools follow it.

transport.camera.title: Camera
transport.camera.text: Turns the webcam control on or off. Click a knob, pinch your thumb and index finger and twist your wrist to turn it. The first time it asks before it downloads the hand models. The camera picture stays in memory and is never saved or sent.

transport.more.title: More transport controls
transport.more.text: The bar has no room for every control in a narrow window. This menu holds the ones that did not fit.

arrangement.track_mute.title: Mute track
arrangement.track_mute.text: Silences this track. A muted track keeps its clips and its place in the mix.

arrangement.track_solo.title: Solo track
arrangement.track_solo.text: Plays only this track and the other soloed tracks. Click again to bring the rest of the song back.

arrangement.track_arm.title: Arm for recording
arrangement.track_arm.text: Arms the track: the next recording writes the notes or audio you play into it. More than one track can be armed.

arrangement.track_expand.title: Show lanes
arrangement.track_expand.text: Shows or hides the automation lanes of this track under its clips.

arrangement.add_lane.title: Add a lane
arrangement.add_lane.text: Adds an automation lane for a parameter of the track's device, chosen from a list. The lane draws how the parameter moves over the song.

arrangement.track_input.title: Audio input
arrangement.track_input.text: The audio input this track records from. Click to choose one of the inputs of the audio interface.

arrangement.track_monitor.title: Input monitoring
arrangement.track_monitor.text: Whether you hear the input while you record. Click to step through off, auto (while recording or stopped) and always on.

arrangement.track_controllers.title: Controller lanes
arrangement.track_controllers.text: This track holds controller lanes of its own, such as mod wheel or pedal. Click to edit them in the piano roll.

arrangement.track_keys.title: Master keyboard
arrangement.track_keys.text: The arrow marks the track that your MIDI keyboard plays. In the separated keyboard mode, click it to choose another track.

arrangement.lane_mute.title: Mute lane
arrangement.lane_mute.text: Silences this lane. A muted automation lane leaves its parameter at the value it holds.

arrangement.lane_solo.title: Solo lane
arrangement.lane_solo.text: While a lane is soloed, only the soloed lanes of the track play.

arrangement.lane_delete.title: Delete lane
arrangement.lane_delete.text: Removes this automation lane and all the clips and points on it. You can undo it.

arrangement.lane_fold.title: Fold lane
arrangement.lane_fold.text: Shrinks the lane to a thin strip to save room, or opens it again.

arrangement.lane_arm.title: Arm lane
arrangement.lane_arm.text: Arms this automation lane: moving its parameter while recording writes the movement into the lane.

arrangement.lane_mode.title: Write mode
arrangement.lane_mode.text: How automation recording writes. Overwrite replaces the lane while it records, touch writes only while you hold a control, latch keeps writing after you let go.

arrangement.clear_mutes.title: Clear all mutes
arrangement.clear_mutes.text: Un-mutes every track and lane at once.

arrangement.clear_solos.title: Clear all solos
arrangement.clear_solos.text: Turns every solo off at once, so the whole song plays again.

arrangement.quantize.title: Quantize
arrangement.quantize.text: Quantizes the selected clips with the last settings of the quantize panel. Right-click to open the panel.

arrangement.manual_rec.title: Manual Rec
arrangement.manual_rec.text: When it is on, selecting a track no longer arms it. Arm tracks yourself with their R buttons.

arrangement.snap.title: Snap grid
arrangement.snap.text: The grid that clips and points snap to while you draw and move them. Click to step to the next value, or drag or scroll to choose.

arrangement.tool_select.title: Select tool
arrangement.tool_select.text: The tool for everyday work: click to select, drag to move or resize, and drag on an empty place to box-select.

arrangement.tool_pencil.title: Pencil tool
arrangement.tool_pencil.text: Click on a lane to draw a clip, or an automation point on an automation lane. Drag to draw a longer clip.

arrangement.tool_eraser.title: Eraser tool
arrangement.tool_eraser.text: Click a clip or a point to delete it. Drag across several to delete them all.

arrangement.tool_razor.title: Razor tool
arrangement.tool_razor.text: Click a clip to split it at the snapped position, or click in a take row to cut the comp there.

arrangement.tool_speaker.title: Speaker tool
arrangement.tool_speaker.text: Press on an audio clip to hear it as it is in its file, release to stop. It does not move the playhead.

arrangement.tool_mute.title: Mute tool
arrangement.tool_mute.text: Click a clip to mute or unmute it. A muted clip stays where it is and plays silently.

arrangement.tool_magnifier.title: Magnifier tool
arrangement.tool_magnifier.text: Click to zoom in, Shift-click to zoom out, or drag a rectangle to zoom to it.

arrangement.tool_hand.title: Hand tool
arrangement.tool_hand.text: Drag to scroll the view in any direction.

console.fold_all.title: Fold sections
console.fold_all.text: Folds every section of every strip to its header, or unfolds them all again.

console.add_channel.title: Add channel
console.add_channel.text: Adds an empty mix channel, or a channel for an instrument that has none yet.

console.compensation.title: Delay compensation
console.compensation.text: Lines the strips up by their latency, so a plugin that delays its sound does not make that track late.

console.arrange.title: Back to the arrangement
console.arrange.text: Closes the mixer and shows the arrangement again.

console.maximise.title: Maximise the mixer
console.maximise.text: Gives the mixer the whole window, or brings the rack and the arrangement back.

console.clear_solos.title: Clear all solos
console.clear_solos.text: Turns every solo off at once.

console.store_snapshot.title: Store a snapshot
console.store_snapshot.text: Stores the whole mix as a snapshot chip. Click the chip later to recall that mix.

console.compare.title: Compare
console.compare.text: Flips between the live mix and the snapshot, so you can hear what changed.

console.end_compare.title: End compare
console.end_compare.text: Ends the comparison and keeps the live mix as it is.

console.section.title: Strip section
console.section.text: The header of a section of the strips, such as EQ or sends. Click to fold or unfold that section on every strip.

console.output.title: Output
console.output.text: Where this strip's sound goes: the master, a bus or another channel. Click to choose.

console.insert.title: Insert slot
console.insert.text: An effect that sits in the strip's signal path, before the fader. Click to select it or to add one, and drag to change the order.

console.snapshot.title: Snapshot
console.snapshot.text: A stored mix. Click to recall it, double-click to rename it, and right-click for more.

console.group.title: Group
console.group.text: A group moves several strips with one fader. The plate selects the members; right-click it for more.

browser.recursive.title: Include sub-folders
browser.recursive.text: Lists the files of the folder and of every folder inside it in one list.

browser.preview_level.title: Preview level
browser.preview_level.text: How loud the browser plays a file when you preview it. Drag to set it, double-click to go back to 0 dB.

browser.preview.title: Preview
browser.preview.text: When it is on, selecting an audio file plays it so you can hear it before you use it.

browser.sort.title: Sort
browser.sort.text: Sorts the list by this column. Click the same column again to reverse the order.

browser.back.title: Back
browser.back.text: Goes back to the place you looked at before.

browser.forward.title: Forward
browser.forward.text: Goes forward again after going back.

browser.path.title: Path
browser.path.text: The folder you are in. Click any part of the path to go to that folder.

roll.snap.title: Snap grid
roll.snap.text: The grid that notes snap to while you draw and move them. Click to step to the next value, or drag or scroll to choose.

roll.quantize.title: Quantize
roll.quantize.text: Quantizes the selected notes with the last settings of the quantize panel.

roll.quantize_options.title: Quantize options
roll.quantize_options.text: Opens the quantize panel: the grid, the strength, swing, groove and what else the quantize changes.

roll.close.title: Close the piano roll
roll.close.text: Closes the piano roll and shows the arrangement again.

roll.tool_select.title: Select tool
roll.tool_select.text: Click to select notes, drag to move or resize them, and drag on an empty place to box-select.

roll.tool_pencil.title: Pencil tool
roll.tool_pencil.text: Click to draw a note at the snapped position. Drag to draw a longer one.

roll.tool_eraser.title: Eraser tool
roll.tool_eraser.text: Click a note to delete it. Drag across several to delete them all.

roll.tool_razor.title: Razor tool
roll.tool_razor.text: Click a note to split it in two at the snapped position.

roll.tool_other.title: Tool of the arrangement
roll.tool_other.text: This tool works in the arrangement. The piano roll offers the select, pencil, eraser and razor tools.

roll.scale_root.title: Scale root
roll.scale_root.text: The note the scale starts on. Click to choose it.

roll.scale_kind.title: Scale
roll.scale_kind.text: The kind of scale, such as major or minor. Click to choose it.

roll.scale_detect.title: Detect the scale
roll.scale_detect.text: Looks at the notes of the clip and picks the scale that fits them best.

roll.scale_snap.title: Snap to scale
roll.scale_snap.text: When it is on, notes you draw or move jump to the nearest note of the scale.

roll.fold_keys.title: Fold keys
roll.fold_keys.text: Hides the keys that are outside the scale or not used by any note, so the notes that matter get more room.

roll.chord.title: Chord stamp
roll.chord.text: With the pencil, a click drops a whole chord instead of one note. Click to choose which chord.

roll.inversion.title: Chord inversion
roll.inversion.text: Turns the stamped chord upside down. Click for the next inversion, right-click for the previous.

roll.controllers.title: Controller lanes
roll.controllers.text: Shows or hides the controller lanes (mod wheel, pedal, pitch bend) under the velocity lane.

roll.expr_tab.title: Expression curve
roll.expr_tab.text: Picks which curve of the note you edit: pitch (in semitones), pressure or timbre. A tab name in bright text means that curve has points.

roll.expr_range.title: Pitch scale
roll.expr_range.text: How many semitones the pitch plot shows above and below its middle: 48, 24, 12 or 2. Click for the next, right-click for the last. A smaller scale makes small bends easier to draw.

roll.expr_apply.title: Apply curve
roll.expr_apply.text: Copies this curve of the first selected note to the other selected notes, stretched to the length of each. One undo step.

roll.expr_clear.title: Clear expression
roll.expr_clear.text: Removes the pitch, pressure and timbre curves of this note. One undo step.

roll.expr_curve.title: Expression plot
roll.expr_curve.text: Click to add a point. Drag a point to move it (Shift moves finely, Ctrl snaps a pitch to a semitone). Alt-click or double-click a point to delete it. Drag from empty space to select several points, or with the Pencil tool to draw freehand.

launcher.back.title: Back to arrangement
launcher.back.text: Every track plays its own arrangement again, now. It is lit while any track plays a launcher clip.

launcher.record.title: Record launches
launcher.record.text: When it is on and you record, everything you launch is written into the arrangement as clips at the song position where it really started.

launcher.stop_empty.title: Scene stops empty tracks
launcher.stop_empty.text: When it is on, launching a scene also stops the tracks that play a clip but have none in that scene.

launcher.quantize.title: Launch quantize
launcher.quantize.text: How long a launch waits for the next boundary, from none to four bars. Click for the next value.

launcher.stop_all.title: Stop all clips
launcher.stop_all.text: Stops every playing clip at the next launch boundary.

launcher.stop.title: Stop track
launcher.stop.text: Stops the clip this track plays at the next boundary. The track then plays its arrangement again.

launcher.track.title: Track
launcher.track.text: A column of the grid is a track of the arrangement, in the same order and colour.

launcher.slot_play.title: Launch clip
launcher.slot_play.text: Starts this clip at the next launch boundary. It plays from its own start and loops until you stop it or launch another.

launcher.slot.title: Clip slot
launcher.slot.text: Holds one looping clip. Double-click an empty slot to make a clip, double-click a clip to edit it, drag it to move it, and drag with Ctrl held to copy it.

launcher.scene_launch.title: Launch scene
launcher.scene_launch.text: Launches every clip of this row at once, at the next launch boundary.

launcher.scene.title: Scene
launcher.scene.text: A row of the grid. Double-click its name to rename it, and right-click for the list of scene commands.

rack.name.title: Device name
rack.name.text: The name of the device. Double-click to rename it.

rack.fold.title: Fold device
rack.fold.text: Folds the device to a thin strip to save room in the rack, or unfolds it again.

rack.edit_samples.title: Edit samples
rack.edit_samples.text: Opens the sample editor on this device's samples, to trim, loop and slice them.

rack.to_channel.title: Add a mixer channel
rack.to_channel.text: Adds a console channel for this device and routes its sound into it.

rack.sample.title: Sample
rack.sample.text: Records from the audio input straight into this device. Click again to stop; right-click to choose the input.

rack.slice.title: Slice
rack.slice.text: Cuts the loop into slices at its transients. The knob next to it sets how many slices there are.

rack.slices_to_track.title: Slices to track
rack.slices_to_track.text: Lays the slices out as notes on a new track, in their original order, so the loop plays back as written.

rack.sidechain.title: Sidechain source
rack.sidechain.text: Chooses the signal this effect listens to. The effect reacts to that signal instead of its own input.

rack.resonance_find.title: Find resonances
rack.resonance_find.text: Listens to the range between the locators at this device's input and marks the resonances that stick out.

rack.resonance_cut.title: Cut resonances
rack.resonance_cut.text: Cuts the marked resonances with the free bands. The cuts are dynamic: they act only while the peak sounds.

rack.spectrum_ref.title: Second curve
rack.spectrum_ref.text: Draws another strip or the reference track as a second curve over the spectrum, so the two can be compared. The choice is saved with the device.

rack.duck_learn.title: Learn the duck curve
rack.duck_learn.text: Listens to the range between the locators at the key and draws the duck curve from the shape of its hits.

rack.table_edit.title: Table editor
rack.table_edit.text: Opens the table editor: draw frames, set harmonics, morph between frames and clean up a sample.

rack.duck_plot.title: Duck curve
rack.duck_plot.text: Drag a point or the line between two points. Click to add a point, and double-click a point to remove it.

rack.tuner.title: Tuner
rack.tuner.text: Shows or hides the tuner. It reads the input of this track.

rack.preview_player.title: Preview player
rack.preview_player.text: Plays this player and the players after it while the song is stopped. Click again to stop.

rack.container_fold.title: Fold container
rack.container_fold.text: Shows the devices of the container under its panel, or folds them away.

rack.container_open.title: Open container
rack.container_open.text: Shows the devices of the container in a view of their own, one level down.

rack.container_edit.title: Container editor
rack.container_edit.text: Opens the container editor, where you choose the sockets and macro knobs the container shows.

rack.plugin_power.title: Plugin power
rack.plugin_power.text: Switches the plugin on or off. An off plugin uses no CPU and is silent.

rack.plugin_bypass.title: Plugin bypass
rack.plugin_bypass.text: Bypasses the plugin: the dry signal passes through unchanged.

rack.plugin_audio_thread.title: Run on the audio thread
rack.plugin_audio_thread.text: Runs this plugin on the audio thread instead of in its own process. It is faster but a crashing plugin can stop the sound, so it is off by default.

rack.plugin_gui.title: Plugin editor
rack.plugin_gui.text: Opens the plugin's own editor window.

rack.plugin_params.title: Plugin parameters
rack.plugin_params.text: Opens the parameter pane, a list of every parameter of the plugin with search and automation.

rack.plugin_reload.title: Reload plugin
rack.plugin_reload.text: Creates the plugin again from its saved state. Use it after a plugin has crashed.

rack.plugin_relink.title: Relink plugin
rack.plugin_relink.text: Points this stand-in at another installed plugin when the original is missing.

rack.plugin_mpe.title: Send MPE
rack.plugin_mpe.text: Sends the notes to this plugin as MPE: each note on a channel of its own from 2 to 16, with its pitch, pressure and timbre curves as that channel's pitch bend, pressure and CC 74. Use it for a plugin that takes plain MIDI; plugins that take note expressions already get the curves without it.

rack.plugin_cv.title: CV input
rack.plugin_cv.text: A control voltage input of the plugin. Click it to choose the parameter it drives in the parameter pane.

rack.pattern.title: Pattern controls
rack.pattern.text: The buttons of the pattern row: choose, add, copy, clear and edit the patterns of the player. Double-click the preview to open the step grid.

rack.arpeggio.title: Arpeggio controls
rack.arpeggio.text: The order, rate, octaves and step row of the arpeggiator. Click a step to cycle rest, on, tie and accent.

rack.scale_from_clip.title: Scale from clip
rack.scale_from_clip.text: Copies the scale of the clip that is open in the piano roll into this device.

rack.bypass_inserts.title: Bypass insert effects
rack.bypass_inserts.text: Bypasses every insert effect of this strip at once. It is one undo step, and clicking again brings them all back.

rack.show_inserts.title: Show insert effects
rack.show_inserts.text: Shows or hides the insert effects under this strip. The effects keep working while they are hidden.

help.idle.title: Help Mode
help.idle.text: Point at any control to read about it here. Clicks still work as usual.

arrangement.add_track.title: Add a track
arrangement.add_track.text: Adds a song track for this device, so that the notes of its clips play it. The new track comes with its own lanes.

arrangement.add_audio.title: Add an audio track
arrangement.add_audio.text: Adds a track for audio clips. Drop an audio file on it, or arm it and record from an audio input.

status.load.title: Engine load
status.load.text: The share of the time for each audio block that the engine uses, with its peak and the devices that use the most. When it nears 100 % the sound can drop out; freezing a heavy track lowers it.
